title: CAT 2026 Exam Day Guidelines: Slot Timings, Reporting Time, What to Carry and Rules
seoTitle: CAT 2026 Exam Day Guidelines: Timings, What to Carry
seoDescription: CAT 2026 is on 29 November in three slots. See reporting and gate-closing times, what to carry, banned items, section timing and the marking scheme.
excerpt: A clock-by-clock timeline for each CAT slot, a one-table checklist of what to carry and leave home, the 68-question pattern with marking, and what to do if your admit card has an error.
